## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
(Test coverage for all 5 DDs from task-1; this task delivers the unit-tests-passing requirement.)

## Implementation Notes

Create `tests/visual_eval/test_visual_eval_gates.py` with:

- test_variance_gate_pass: toy corpus where all fixtures have variance ≤ 0.5 → gate passes
- test_variance_gate_fail: toy corpus where one fixture has variance > 0.5 → gate fails
- test_accuracy_gate_pass: toy corpus where weighted accuracy ≥ 0.7 → gate passes
- test_accuracy_gate_fail: toy corpus where weighted accuracy < 0.7 → gate fails
- test_skew_gate_pass: corpus with balanced classes (each 20-30%) → gate passes
- test_skew_gate_fail: corpus with one class at 5% → gate fails (<10%)
- test_hallucination_gate_pass: corpus with <20% hallucinated findings → gate passes
- test_hallucination_gate_fail: corpus with 30% hallucinated findings → gate fails
- test_all_gates_pass_exit_0: integration test invoking the bash script on the real corpus with mock label data → exit 0
- test_script_documents_invocation_policy: bash file contains INVOCATION POLICY comment

Add .test-index entries.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] All 10 named test cases present and pass
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/visual_eval/test_visual_eval_gates.py -v

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet)
